slave 1 rejected the "Read Holding Registers" request: Illegal data address — the register being accessed does not exist on the slave

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 03  Length                  3 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
83     Function code           0x83 = 0x03 + 0x80, meaning "Read Holding Registers" raised an exception
02     Exception code          0x02 = Illegal data address — the register being accessed does not exist on the slave

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus TCP (9 bytes total)
Transaction ID: 0x0001
Protocol ID: 0x0000
Length field: 3 (3 bytes actually follow)
Unit ID: 1
Function: 0x83 (0x03 | 0x80, exception response)
Exception code: 0x02 (Illegal data address)
